candidates.title: [ROCm][QuickReduce] Q8 BF16→FP16 low-amplitude scale saturation attenuates all-reduce output
candidates.snippet: ## Summary  With `ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT8` and `ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_CAST_BF16_TO_FP16=1`, the ROCm two-shot `CodecQ8<half>` path can **strongly attenuate finite BF16 all-reduce inputs whose 32-value block maxima are below ~2e-3**. candidates.title: Prefill CUDA graph reserves ~1.8 GB and starves quantized-KV long-context prefill on small cards (no auto-disable rule looks at free VRAM)
candidates.snippet: ## Summary  On a small-VRAM card, the prefill CUDA graph and a length-proportional KV dequant workspace compete for the same memory, and nothing in the resolution path notices. The result is not an OOM — the server starts fine and then stalls at long context while still reporting 100% GPU utilisation.
